blocks.title: The factorial

runs.text: . Calls pile up until the base case and are then resolved from the top down.

blocks.description: Four frames stacked from Factorial(4) to Factorial(1). The base case returns 1 and every frame multiplies: 2, 6 and 24.

caption.text: stacks four frames, each with its own
. The top one resolves first and hands its value to the one below.

runs.text: The base case returns 1 and its frame disappears.
Every frame multiplies and returns: 2, 6 and finally 24.
Nothing needs to be declared in advance, and two subprograms can call each other:

blocks.title: Mutual recursion

runs.text: A recursion without a base case does not hang or break anything: the engine stops it with
. The app allows at least 1000 frames.

blocks.title: No base case

points.text: A recursive subprogram calls itself with a smaller problem.
It needs a base case that answers without calling itself.
Every call has its own frame.
Without a base case, the engine stops it when depth runs out.
